name: workspai
description: Workspai monorepo for Workspace Intelligence packages.
author: Chistiq

scripts.check:package-infrastructure: corepack npm run check:package-quality && corepack npm run check:package-boundaries && corepack npm run check:package-mirrors && corepack npm --workspace @workspai/shared run check && corepack npm --workspace @workspai/graph run check
scripts.check: corepack npm run check:cross-platform-lockfile && corepack npm run check:english-text && corepack npm run check:package-quality && corepack npm run check:package-boundaries && corepack npm run check:package-mirrors && corepack npm --workspaces --if-present run check
scripts.install:local: corepack npm install --ignore-scripts && corepack npm run build && corepack npm --workspace workspai link && corepack npm --workspace wspai link
scripts.uninstall:local: corepack npm unlink -g workspai || true && corepack npm unlink -g wspai || true
scripts.reinstall:local: corepack npm run uninstall:local && corepack npm run install:local
scripts.prepush:check: corepack npm run check:cross-platform-lockfile && corepack npm --workspace workspai run contracts:prepush && corepack npm run check:brand && corepack npm run check:package-quality && corepack npm run check:package-boundaries && corepack npm run check:package-mirrors && corepack npm --workspace workspai run quality:push && corepack npm --workspace wspai run smoke
